title: File Drop
subtitle: Receive files from Android Quick Share
receiveHelp: Open receiving for your account, then select PaNasMs in Quick Share on your Android phone. Confirm each transfer here after comparing the PIN on both devices.
busy: Another user is receiving files now. Try again later.
folderHelp: Choose a folder in your home. Incoming files are written with your Linux account permissions.
checkPin: Compare this PIN with the one on your Android device. Accept only if they match.
